UPL-310:
REQUIREMENT: Profile Avatar Upload
Users shall be able to upload an avatar image to their profile.
Uploaded images must be stored securely.
The feature should accept all common image formats.
SESS-101:
REQUIREMENT: Session Timeout
Sessions shall expire after a reasonable period of inactivity.
Users must be warned before expiry.
Expired sessions should be handled appropriately.
The system shall log every expiry.
EXP-202:
REQUIREMENT: Report Export
Users shall be able to export reports.
Exports must complete quickly.
Exported files should use common formats.
The system shall record each export.
RATE-303:
REQUIREMENT: API Rate Limiting
The API shall limit request rates per client.
Limits must be sensible for normal usage.
Clients exceeding limits should be notified appropriately.
The system shall record rejected requests.
AUD-404:
REQUIREMENT: Audit Logging
The system shall log privileged actions.
Logs must be retained for a reasonable period.
Logs should be searchable easily.
Log access shall itself be logged.
SRCH-505:
REQUIREMENT: Search
Search shall return matching items.
Results must load quickly.
Common misspellings should be tolerated.
The system shall record search queries.
